blind.description: A miniature decorative cremation urn or lidded vase. It consists of a pedestal foot, a bulbous body with a horizontal tan/gold decorative middle band, and a domed lid capped with a small rounded finial knob. The surfaces are smooth, continuous, and solid with a dark green marble or patina texture accented by gold-toned trim rings. The underside sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A small concentric circle showing the top finial point surrounded by circular rings of the domed lid and outer rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 8 to 10 inches tall and 6 inches wide, reaching only to the ankle level of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
